anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved: in both outputs every checkpoint (wrong PR number, malformed bytes, wrong base repository, case-mismatched base branch) fails validation, discards the retained fix/merge-base grants, leaves the file untouched, withholds `merge base`, and stops at a menu awaiting a fresh human pick, so no write is authorized from the record. The Change itself (terminal-menu cleanup row, stop leaving the checkout as found) is not exercised here because the menu is non-terminal (fixable, merge conflict), and After correctly does not surface a cleanup row. Two small things After dropped that cost nothing to keep: the explicit closing sentence 'no write reaches the forge, nothing is merged or pushed' and the per-checkpoint obstacle line in the report body; both made the no-authority outcome visible in the rendered text rather than only in the `Not offered:` tail. Consider restoring a one-line 'No forge write is made at any checkpoint' statement so a reader does not have to infer it from the absence of helper dispatch.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: No fact moved: both Before and After refuse every write at all four checkpoints (no helper, git, fetch, merge, rebase, commit, or push; grants left unconsumed; fix/merge base/update branch withheld) and offer only show evidence and stop. The Change concerns terminal menus (own merge, approved, merged/closed), which none of these pause menus are, so there was nothing for After to deliver here and it correctly introduces no cleanup row. One wording wrinkle in After worth tightening: the preamble says it does not 'initialize tracker stages' yet step 2 says it 'Start[s] the report tracker stage' and later 'close[s] report and start[s] menu' - clarify that these are advancing existing stages of the resumed run rather than initializing new ones, to avoid a reader thinking the run is being re-minted. Otherwise After's explicit 'fix' row in the Not offered list and its 'exact, case-sensitive match' / 'lowercasing does not make them equal' statements are good additions that make the no-write stance even more legible than Before.
